description: Plans a day outside in a US launch metro: National Weather Service forecast, a conditions read for the specific activity (rain, storms, wind, heat, clouds), sunrise/sunset/full-dark times, moon phase, practical tips, and local context. Good for stargazing, fishing, hiking, birding, bouldering, paddling, hunting, cold-water swimming, disc golf and more.

activity.description: What they want to do, e.g. "stargazing", "fishing", "hiking", "bird watching", "bouldering", "kayaking".

date.description: "today", "tomorrow", a weekday, "this weekend", or YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the coming Saturday. Forecasts reach ~7 days ahead.

metro.description: City or launch metro, e.g. "Knoxville", "Johnson City", "Denver". Supported: Knoxville, Tri-Cities, Chattanooga, Asheville, Denver, Salt Lake City, Seattle, Boise, Austin, Dallas–Fort Worth, Jacksonville, Memphis, Nashville, Raleigh–Durham, Richmond, Sacramento, San Antonio, San Francisco, Tampa, Virginia Beach.

name: plan_outdoor_outing
title: Plan an Outdoor Outing
